column1: # Security advisory floors for the native components shipped under resources/.
# Floors come from primary advisories (NVD, GitHub Security Advisories, upstream
# security pages, OSV) checked on 2026-09-25 against the versions physically shipped.
# The inventory gate refuses any shipped version of a component below a floor.
# A floor is never lowered without a written exemption.
# floor is the first fixed release. When it lists several comma-separated versions,
# each applies to its own release branch (same major.minor); a version on no listed
# branch is held to the lowest listed floor.
# A row with floor "-" and advisory "none" records a component audited clean.
# Reachability is recorded in the disposition; it never exempts a row.
